svg.title: Random · Maximum final height · edges
svg.desc: Measurements for 2 implementations. Logarithmic key counts and linear vertical scale. Only complete groups are plotted; missing or censored groups leave gaps. Whiskers show one standard error for averages when repeated trials exist. Maximum final height is the maximum observed across those trials. Dashed gray line: 2.46·log₂(n) · endpoint guide. c=max(1, largest endpoint value/log₂(n) across implementations). Descriptive scaling, not a proven bound.
svg.text: 2 implementations · source and seeds recorded · no timing comparison

path.title: 2.46·log₂(n) · endpoint guide: descriptive scaling, not a proven bound
